wacc.source: Assumption. A defensive grocer with a beta of about 0.5-0.6, a risk-free rate of about 3%, an equity risk premium of about 5.5% and moderate leverage. Not taken from a data provider.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption. In line with long-run euro/US inflation and below nominal GDP.

net_debt.source: WARNING: this is company-reported net debt at 28 Dec 2025 (Q4 2025 summary report) and it INCLUDES lease liabilities. It does not follow the convention of excluding leases. The year-end lease liability was not found because the search limit was hit. The reviewer must subtract lease liabilities. Left as reported, it will understate equity value (leases are partly captured in EBIT through lease depreciation).

diluted_shares.source: Derived, not read from a filing. Underlying income from continuing operations of EUR 2,414m divided by diluted underlying EPS of EUR 2.67 gives about 904m shares (Q4 2025 report). Q1 2025 diluted weighted average was 916m. The reviewer should check against the AR2025 EPS note. Millions.
